title: RobustMQ: Benchmarking Robustness of Quantized Models
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a benchmark (RobustMQ) for the robustness of quantized models against various types of noise (adversarial attacks, natural corruptions, and systematic noises) in computer vision tasks. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component. While it mentions 'fairness' in the abstract as a general aspect of trustworthiness, the detailed evaluation metrics and experiments do not focus on this aspect.
